title: Payroll Changes – Submission Procedure (Belgium) v4
text:
Payroll Changes – Submission Procedure (Belgium), version 4
Owner: Sofie Peeters, Payroll Operations BE

1. Purpose
This procedure describes how consultants submit changes (new hires, salary changes, leavers, allowances) for the monthly payroll run of Belgian customers.

2. Cut-off
All changes for the monthly run must be submitted in the customer portal by the 18th of the month at 12:00 (noon) CET. Changes received after the cut-off are processed in the following month's run.

3. Submission steps
- Collect the signed change form from the customer.
- Enter the change in the portal and attach the form.
- Confirm receipt to the customer by email.

4. Exceptions
Urgent corrections after the cut-off must be escalated to the BE Payroll Operations lead.

title: Payroll Calendar 2024 – Belgium
text:
Payroll Calendar 2024 – Belgium

Monthly run schedule
- Deadline for submitting payroll changes: 20th of each month.
- Payroll calculation: 22nd to 24th.
- Payslips published: 25th.
- Bank file sent: 27th.

Public holidays in 2024 may shift these dates. Check the holiday list before confirming a deadline to a customer.

title: Payroll Changes – Submission Procedure (Netherlands) v7
text:
Payroll Changes – Submission Procedure (Netherlands), version 7
Owner: Daan de Vries, Payroll Operations NL

1. Purpose
This procedure describes how consultants submit changes for the monthly payroll run of Dutch customers.

2. Cut-off
All changes for the monthly run must be submitted in the customer portal by the 15th of the month at 17:00 CET. Later changes are processed in the next run.

3. Submission steps
- Obtain the signed mutatieformulier from the customer.
- Enter the change in the portal and attach the form.
- Confirm receipt to the customer by email.

title: Late Submission Fees & Penalty Schedule (Finance only)
text:
Late Submission Fees & Penalty Schedule
Internal reference FIN-CONFIDENTIAL-7741. Do not share outside Finance.

Changes submitted after the cut-off and processed out of cycle incur a rush fee of EUR 45 per payslip. Repeated late submissions by the same customer (three or more in a quarter) trigger a review by the account manager. Fee waivers require written approval from Finance.

title: Payroll Tips & Tricks (Wiki)
text:
Payroll Tips & Tricks

Tip 1: Always double-check the employee's national register number before entering a new hire.
Tip 2: When a customer sends several changes, batch them in one portal submission.
Tip 3: Keep the customer's signed change forms for at least 7 years.

title: Holiday Pay Calculation – Belgium
text:
Holiday Pay Calculation – Belgium
Owner: Lien Wouters

Holiday pay depends on the employee's statute. Before calculating, confirm whether the employee is a worker or an employee, and check the days worked in the reference year. Holiday pay is settled through the monthly payroll run. Any disputes about the number of holiday days are escalated to the BE Payroll Operations lead.

title: New Consultant Onboarding Checklist
text:
New Consultant Onboarding Checklist
Owner: Nora Jacobs, HR Onboarding

Week 1: laptop and accounts, security awareness training, meet your buddy.
Week 2: shadow two customer calls, read the core procedures for your country.
Week 3: handle your first customer tickets with your buddy reviewing.
Week 4: feedback session with your team lead and plan your learning goals.

title: Expense Claims Policy
text:
Expense Claims Policy
Owner: Femke Claes, Finance Operations

Employees submit expense claims in the expense tool with the original receipt attached. Claims must be submitted by the 5th of the month following the expense. Travel within the country is reimbursed at the standard mileage rate. Claims above EUR 250 need manager approval before submission.

title: Payslip Delivery Schedule (Belgium)
text:
Payslip Delivery Schedule (Belgium)
Owner: Lien Wouters

After the monthly payroll run is closed, payslips are published in the customer portal on the 25th of each month. Customers receive a notification email the same day. If the 25th falls on a weekend, payslips are published on the preceding working day. Questions about missing payslips go to the BE support queue.

title: Client Portfolio Handover Template
text:
Client Portfolio Handover Template
Owner: Nora Jacobs

For each customer in the portfolio, record: main contacts, contract and plan, special agreements, recurring issues, open tickets, and where relevant documents live. Schedule a one-hour call between the outgoing and incoming consultant, and list any colleagues who hold knowledge that is not written down.
